fusions.name: Lick of Lime
fusions.desc: Flicks a lick of wet mortar at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Trench Spring
fusions.desc: Springs 6 tiles out of the footing trench onto the target and strikes it, which deals 15 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Damp Plaster Skin
fusions.desc: A coat of damp plaster absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet-Set Hop
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you gain a ward that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum health for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
